contract.sync_assumed: the warp is converged on entry, the caller separates calls that reuse the output buffer by a __syncwarp (the harness does)
contract.sync_performed: ballots over the full warp mask only, no shared memory, no barriers
contract.n_range: N = 32 x IPT, a multiple of 32 up to 32768, measured 128 and 256
contract.type_constraints: bf16 (16 bit passes) and fp32 (32 bit passes) with minus zero folded onto plus zero, int32 indices derived from the position
contract.nan_behavior: unsupported (the image of NaN is unordered), focus-set inputs contain no NaN
contract.tie_break_support: inherent: the tie class at the k-th key is taken in index order by ballot ranks, both requirements run the same code
contract.sorted_output_support: not inherent (index order), post-sort of k
